</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">*</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">200</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">multipart/related</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[one output per part]</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="#req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-value-multi">/req/core/process-execute-sync-raw-value-multi</a>
</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">reference</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">1</td><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">204</td><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">none</td><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[empty with <tt>Link</tt> headers]</td><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="#req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-ref">/req/core/process-execute-sync-raw-ref</a>
</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">*</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">mixed</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">*</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">200</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">multipart/related</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[one output per part]</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="#req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-mixed-multi">/req/core/process-execute-sync-raw-mixed-multi</a>
</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="4" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">document</td><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">value</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">1</td><td rowspan="4" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">200</td><td rowspan="4" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">application/json</td><td rowspan="4" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/results.yaml">results.yaml</a>
</td><td rowspan="4" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="#req_core_process-execute-sync-document">/req/core/process-execute-sync-document</a>
</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">*</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">reference</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">1</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">*</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">async</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">
<i>any</i>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">
<i>any</i>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">
<i>any</i>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">201</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">application/json</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">
<a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/statusInfo.yaml">statusInfo.yaml</a>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">
<a href="#req_core_process-execute-success-async">/req/core/process-execute-success-async</a>
</td></tr></tbody><tfoot><tr><td colspan="8" style="border-top:0pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;"><div class="Note" id="_d3c2fc0a-8c8a-8205-47ef-7060006f24ad"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE</span>  The value <i>any</i> in a cell means <i>“for any valid value of the execute parameter represented by that cell”</i>.</p><p id="_3d69efdd-9112-bea1-5fa2-75a295e36426">This table shows all possible combinations of execute parameters that are specified by this standard.  Not all of these combinations need to be implemented by a server conforming to this standard.  For example, if a server only offers processes that support multiple outputs <b>by value</b>, then the server <b>must</b> support <tt>multipart/related</tt> responses as indicated in <a href="#table_core_execute_responses">Table 11</a>.  If, on the other hand, the server only offers processes that support multiple outputs <b>by reference</b>, then the server does not need to support <tt>multipart/related</tt> responses.</p></div></td></tr></tfoot></table>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_5f3b868f-78c2-12a9-38f3-1df393a777c7">additionalProperties:<br/>  $ref: "inlineOrRefData.yaml"</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 19 — Schema for a processing results presented as a document</p>
<div class="Note" id="_385c5932-d0ed-b4fb-5ff0-21c3c1ce3aa9"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  1</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/results.yaml"><tt>results.yaml</tt></a>.</p></div>
<p id="_f8694d70-07eb-1428-25dd-08ce0065b2fe">This schema defines a map using the respective output identifier as the key. The value of an output can be returned as an in-line value or by reference.</p>
<p id="_9b34a4f5-bb9a-0f7a-39d7-13704e3d7227">For a synchronous execution, the following requirements apply:</p>
<span id="req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-value-one"></span><!-- requirement: core/process-execute-sync-raw-value-one -->
<span id="req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-value-multi"></span><!-- requirement: core/process-execute-sync-raw-value-multi -->
<span id="req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-ref"></span><!-- requirement: core/process-execute-sync-raw-ref -->
<span id="req_core_process-execute-sync-raw-mixed-multi"></span><!-- requirement: core/process-execute-sync-raw-mixed-multi -->
<span id="req_core_process-execute-sync-document"></span><!-- requirement: core/process-execute-sync-document -->
<table class="recommend" id="rec_core_process-execute-sync-document-ref" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 15</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/core/process-execute-sync-document-ref</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">Conditions</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<ol id="_123fc16d-1bda-cb4f-5dec-73b476a98e45" type="1">
<li>
<p id="_babc670f-0ed9-da89-50e4-6861d8e6750a">The <a href="#sc_execution_mode">negotiated execution mode</a> is synchronous, <tt>response=document</tt>, <tt>transmissionMode=reference</tt></p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_8658163a-f1d1-2ed3-b3f5-6975e548fcb6">The number of outputs requested is 1 or more.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_67126855-767a-030b-82ac-2e67c366eb30">The requested output value is a simple scalar value.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">A</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_275c26a8-c9c9-a81a-6ff7-778dfd15b090">For a simple scalar values servers SHOULD consider supporting links to <tt>text/plain</tt> files that contain the output values.</p>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p id="_47d993d8-59e5-866d-89d5-a60eb95e77ec">This specification does not mandate that servers create a job as a result of executing a process synchronously.  However the following permission is given:</p>
<span id="per_core_process-execute-sync-job"></span><!-- permission: core/process-execute-sync-job -->
<p id="_358b7200-dca1-2415-6189-7d9563dcecd8">For servers that implement this permission and do create a job as a result of synchronous execution of a process, the following requirement applies:</p>
<span id="req_core_job-results-success-sync"></span><!-- requirement: core/job-results-success-sync -->
<p id="_a96c9ffc-bed7-6008-7afc-20f036b0aff1">The job reference in the header can then be used to <a href="#async-fetch">re-fetch the results</a> of the original synchronous execution.</p>
<p id="_b34e68c7-0da2-c954-d48c-dca955558465">In the case of asynchronous execution, the following requirement applies:</p>
<span id="req_core_process-execute-success-async"></span><!-- requirement: core/process-execute-success-async --></div>
<div id="_error_situations_6"><h3 class="published-heading">7.11.5.  Error situations</h3><p id="_ba235835-be85-f46a-302e-ff84c72f93ea">See <a href="#http_status_codes">Clause 7.5.1</a> for general guidance.</p>
<p id="_918f4dd0-03d3-17c3-df8c-9f8f737d870e">If the process with the specified identifier does not exist on the server, see requirement <a href="#req_core_process-exception-no-such-process">/req/core/process-exception/no-such-process</a>.</p></div></div>
<div id="sc_retrieve_status_info"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc33">7.12.  Retrieve status information about a job</h2><p id="_15d4ecba-ec2c-5ca4-618a-508c640ac463">The following section describes the requirements to retrieve information about the status of a job.</p>
<div id="_operation_7"><h3 class="published-heading">7.12.1.  Operation</h3>
<span id="req_core_job"></span><!-- requirement: core/job -->
</div>
<div id="_response_6"><h3 class="published-heading">7.12.2.  Response</h3><span id="req_core_job-success"></span><!-- requirement: core/job-success -->
<pre class="prettyprint" id="schema-statusInfo">type: object<br/>required:<br/>   - jobID<br/>   - status<br/>   - type<br/>properties:<br/>   processID:<br/>      type: string<br/>   type:<br/>      type: string<br/>      enum:<br/>        - process<br/>   jobID:<br/>      type: string<br/>   status:<br/>      $ref: "statusCode.yaml"<br/>   message:<br/>      type: string<br/>   created:<br/>      type: string<br/>      format: date-time<br/>   started:<br/>      type: string<br/>      format: date-time<br/>   finished:<br/>      type: string<br/>      format: date-time<br/>   updated:<br/>      type: string<br/>      format: date-time<br/>   progress:<br/>      type: integer<br/>      minimum: 0<br/>      maximum: 100<br/>   links:<br/>      type: array<br/>      items:<br/>         $ref: "link.yaml"</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 20 — Schema for status info</p>
<div class="Note" id="_95349d55-57c8-246b-6f81-c4fcd28f1912"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  1</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/statusInfo.yaml"><tt>statusInfo.yaml</tt></a>.</p></div>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_11de0cd6-7c05-4951-b0f0-2a801c554ac2">type: string<br/>nullable: false<br/>enum:<br/>  - accepted<br/>  - running<br/>  - successful<br/>  - failed<br/>  - dismissed</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 21 — Schema for status codes</p>
<div class="Note" id="_21da9cbc-92fd-c19c-7b34-37ab6f9fc7fb"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  2</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/statusCode.yaml"><tt>statusCode.yaml</tt></a>.</p></div>
<p id="_9c760e31-b2c6-5233-e8bd-d8583aad6919">The job status information includes several optional date-time fields that represent milestones in the life cycle of a job.   The following are recommended for servers that decide to populate some or all of these date-time fields:</p>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_core_job-status" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 16</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/core/job-status</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">A</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_19088dd3-1f0e-e7e3-c1a7-4df578d1e7d6">Servers SHOULD set the value of the <tt>processID</tt> field if it is known.</p>
</td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">B</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_246faba0-46d5-ebf0-8341-48424ea2813e">Servers SHOULD set the value of the <tt>created</tt> field when a job has been accepted and queued for execution.</p>
</td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">C</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_53d27122-b859-1483-0b77-47bff4ffec0a">Servers SHOULD set the value of the <tt>started</tt> field when a job begins execution and is consuming compute resources.</p>
</td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">D</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_080980d0-b4ba-b813-57da-e5c52b8c352c">Servers SHOULD set the value of the <tt>finished</tt> field when the execution of a job has completed and the process is no longer consuming compute resources.</p>
</td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">E</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_01623c38-101d-f3d5-fa79-88c6d24c7564">Whenever the <tt>status</tt> field of the job changes, servers SHOULD revise the value of the <tt>updated</tt> field.</p>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
<div class="Note" id="_b54937a9-6c87-bd38-f4ac-f92e53444b35"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  3</span>  Once a job has finished execution and is no longer consuming compute resources, the duration of processing can be computed as <tt>finished-started</tt>.  The <tt>updated</tt> field, however, may still be revised as the system continues processing outputs, storing results, releasing compute resources, etc.</p></div>
<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  1 — A HTTP GET request for retrieving status information about a job encoded as JSON.</p><div class="example" id="_429b8e6f-7b1e-27c4-d8eb-37bfc13c6617"><pre class="prettyprint" id="_3bf9fb6d-596f-5d13-fb34-e09e627156ba">GET /jobs/81574318-1eb1-4d7c-af61-4b3fbcf33c4f HTTP/1.1<br/>Host: processing.example.org</pre>
</div>
<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  2 — A job encoded as JSON.</p><div class="example" id="_feb2c74b-8624-020a-478a-bb5a6dbd32ad"><pre class="prettyprint" id="_7222fb6b-27b0-6497-703c-dd03f20b6944">{<br/>  "jobID" : "81574318-1eb1-4d7c-af61-4b3fbcf33c4f",<br/>  "status": "accepted",<br/>  "message": "Process started",<br/>  "progress": 0,<br/>  "created": "2021-05-04T10:13:00+05:00",<br/>  "links": [<br/>    {<br/>      "href": "http://processing.example.org/oapi-p/jobs/81574318-1eb1-4d7c-af61-4b3fbcf33c4f",<br/>      "rel": "self",<br/>      "type": "application/json",<br/>      "title": "this document"<br/>    }<br/>  ]<br/>}</pre>
</div></div>
<div id="_error_situations_7"><h3 class="published-heading">7.12.3.  Error situations</h3><p id="_5c4a4f5c-92f1-e34e-8fec-9995c0f515d2">See <a href="#http_status_codes">Clause 7.5.1</a> for general guidance.</p>
<p id="_badeda07-b654-3de1-99ce-9dd6c6318d12">If the process with the specified identifier does not exist on the server, see requirement <a href="#req_core_process-exception-no-such-process">/req/core/process-exception/no-such-process</a>.</p>
<span id="req_core_job-exception-no-such-job"></span><!-- requirement: core/job-exception-no-such-job --></div></div>
<div id="sc_retrieve_job_results"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc34">7.13.  Retrieve job results</h2><p id="_d63bb005-3a88-06b3-4375-4b4f6cfaa37b">The following section describes the requirements to retrieve the results of a job. In case the job execution failed, an exception is returned.</p>
<div id="_operation_8"><h3 class="published-heading">7.13.1.  Operation</h3>
<span id="req_core_job-results"></span><!-- requirement: core/job-results -->
</div>
<div id="_response_7"><h3 class="published-heading">7.13.2.  Response</h3><p id="_a795e7f9-1c15-2479-e9d3-f847fa915def">The manner in which a server responds when retrieving job results depends on the values of the following parameters used in the execute request that created the job:</p>
<ul id="_eef6f6a1-86d2-df28-8449-1ea1c9486a33">
<li>
<p id="_922ff082-5ae4-2782-5546-9dc383b3314c">the <a href="#sc_execution_mode">negotiated execution mode</a> (synchronous or asynchronous),</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_fce292b3-24c2-9f94-a1c6-da9304c0a34e">the <tt>response</tt> parameter (<tt>document</tt> or <tt>raw</tt>),</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_73d2e402-b25c-7438-1947-fe3617a6c7c9">the <tt>transmissionMode</tt> parameter (<tt>value</tt> or <tt>reference</tt>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_19fb2e4d-01ea-028a-068e-caab9cd73f54">and the number of output requested.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p id="_fc84a81e-05ad-86cb-74c0-3c230cf053f4">The following table maps the possible responses based on the combinations of these execute parameters.</p>
<p class="TableTitle" style="text-align:center;">Table 12 — Table mapping get results responses based on the input parameter values used on the original execute request.</p><table class="MsoISOTable" id="table_core_getresults_responses" style="border-width:1px;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th scope="col" style="font-weight:bold;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">sync</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<i>any</i>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<i>any</i>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<i>any</i>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">no</td><td colspan="4" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[if the server creates a job on synchronous execute, job results may be re-fetched at any time <a href="#async-fetch">as per async</a>]</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="8" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;"><a id="async-fetch"></a>async</td><td rowspan="5" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">raw</td><td rowspan="2" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">value</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">1</td><td rowspan="8" style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">yes</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">200</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[as per output definition from process description]</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[output in requested output format]</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">

</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">*</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">200</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">multipart/related</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">[one output per part]</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">

<p id="_72294ebe-04b7-cb7b-9b3c-8ffe9c6a393d">The following requirements apply when retrieving the results of a job that was created by executing a process synchronously OR was created by execution a process synchronously on a server that creates a job even on synchronous execution:</p>

</div>
